title: Minor Hydraulic Fluid Leak at Boom Cylinder
description: Small hydraulic fluid leak observed at boom cylinder connection during routine maintenance inspection. Leak rate approximately 2-3 drops per minute.
rootCause: Worn O-ring seal in hydraulic fitting
correctiveAction: Replace O-ring seal and tighten fitting to specification
preventiveAction: Include fitting inspection in regular maintenance schedule

attachments.description: Photo showing hydraulic fluid leak location

notes: Monitor for recurring leak after repair. May indicate broader seal degradation issue.

title: Metal Contamination in Transmission Fluid
description: Significant metal particles found in transmission fluid during diagnostic inspection. Particles consistent with gear wear indicating internal transmission damage.
rootCause: Faulty transmission solenoid causing improper shift timing and gear wear
correctiveAction: Replaced transmission solenoid, performed complete fluid flush, replaced filter
preventiveAction: Implement more frequent transmission fluid analysis program

attachments.description: Detailed fluid analysis showing metal particle concentration
Photo of contaminated transmission fluid sample

notes: Transmission operation normal after repair. Continue monitoring fluid condition closely.

title: Damaged Bolt Threads in Blade Mount
description: One bolt hole in blade mount has damaged threads discovered during cutting edge replacement. Thread damage prevents proper torque application.
rootCause: Overtightening of bolt during previous maintenance caused thread stripping
correctiveAction: Drill out damaged threads, install thread insert, re-tap to original size
preventiveAction: Ensure proper torque specifications are followed, provide torque wrench training

attachments.description: Photo showing stripped threads in blade mounting hole

notes: Thread repair in progress. Will need to monitor for thread insert stability.

assetName: Drill Rig Atlas Copco ROC L8
title: Excessive Drill Bit Wear Pattern
description: Three drill bits showing premature and uneven wear patterns indicating possible drilling parameter issues or rock formation changes.
rootCause: Drilling parameters not optimized for current rock formation hardness
correctiveAction: Replaced worn bits, adjusted drilling speed and pressure parameters
preventiveAction: Implement bit wear monitoring program, adjust parameters based on geological survey

attachments.description: Comparison photo of worn vs new drill bits
Analysis of optimal drilling parameters for current formation

notes: New drilling parameters implemented. Monitor bit life improvement over next drilling cycle.

title: Engine Power Loss and Excessive Smoke
description: Significant engine power loss reported by operator along with black smoke emission during operation. Engine performance degraded to approximately 60% of normal power output.
rootCause: Worn piston rings and cylinder liner causing compression loss and oil burning
correctiveAction: Complete engine overhaul including piston ring replacement, cylinder honing, valve adjustment
preventiveAction: Implement more frequent engine oil analysis, monitor compression readings

attachments.description: Video showing excessive smoke during operation
Compression test results showing cylinder performance

notes: Major overhaul in progress. Engine removed and in rebuild shop. Expected completion by end of week.

title: Belt Splice Separation at Transfer Point
description: Main conveyor belt splice has separated at transfer point causing material spillage and system shutdown. Splice appears to have failed due to excessive stress.
rootCause: Belt splice weakened by repeated stress cycles and inadequate maintenance schedule
correctiveAction: Remove damaged belt section, prepare new splice with reinforced design
preventiveAction: Increase splice inspection frequency, implement belt tension monitoring system

attachments.description: Engineering diagram for splice repair procedure

notes: Critical repair scheduled for night shift to minimize production impact. Emergency shutdown procedures implemented.

title: Load Block Swivel Bearing Wear
description: Excessive play detected in load block swivel bearing during pre-operation inspection. Bearing shows signs of wear that could compromise load stability.
rootCause: Normal wear from extended service, insufficient lubrication schedule
correctiveAction: Replace swivel bearing assembly, upgrade lubrication fittings
preventiveAction: Implement weekly swivel bearing inspection, improve lubrication schedule
notes: Crane taken out of service immediately for safety. Critical repair required before return to operation.

title: Intermittent Dashboard Warning Lights
description: Multiple dashboard warning lights intermittently activating without apparent cause. Engine temperature, oil pressure, and hydraulic system lights affected.
rootCause: Loose connection in main wiring harness causing intermittent signal loss
correctiveAction: Inspect and secure all dashboard wiring connections, replace damaged connectors
preventiveAction: Include wiring harness inspection in regular electrical system checks
notes: Intermittent issue makes diagnosis challenging. May require extended monitoring period.

title: Track Drive Motor Oil Seepage
description: Minor oil seepage observed from track drive motor housing. No active dripping but visible oil staining on track frame.
rootCause: Aging motor housing gasket allowing minor oil seepage
correctiveAction: Replace track drive motor gasket and seals
preventiveAction: Include track drive motor inspection in monthly service schedule

attachments.description: Photo showing oil staining on track frame

notes: Minor issue but should be addressed to prevent environmental impact and component damage.

title: Uneven Material Distribution Pattern
description: Material distribution showing uneven pattern across paving width. Left side receiving approximately 15% less material than right side.
rootCause: Worn auger flight on left side causing reduced material transfer
correctiveAction: Replace worn auger flights, calibrate distribution system
preventiveAction: Implement daily material distribution checks, scheduled auger inspection

attachments.description: Detailed measurements of material distribution across paving width

notes: Distribution issue affecting paving quality. Repair scheduled during next planned maintenance window.
